model_provenance.note: Same verified unchanged Qwen3.5:0.8b weights as the baseline. Live identity is verified separately for each local runtime session.

corpus_provenance.selection_note: General historical topics chosen from observed gaps on the public development paper. These are encyclopedia articles, not exam solutions. Selection has seen the development questions; evaluation is not held out.
corpus_provenance.transform: Exact paragraph/sentence spans; title and section prefixes; omit bibliography/navigation; no generated facts or exam answer keys
corpus_provenance.quality_limit: Provenance and passage boundaries verified; encyclopedia claims are not independently fact-checked
corpus_provenance.verification: Every indexed passage matches its exact article span plus title/section prefix; unique IDs and canonical titles; no secondary splitting

experiment_note: Retrieval-policy-only change versus concise BM25 v3: full cleaned query, referenced-source selection, five-character Polish lexical prefixes, title-weighted BM25, lexical overlap gate and at most two passages per article. Same 89-article corpus, tiny model, answer prompt, exam and one-call budget. Development paper, provisional grades.
